featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The CAB-UAOC-USBC-10M delivers cutting-edge performance with its adaptive 2- or 4-lane USB-C design. Built with dual MCU chip technology, it intelligently adjusts between DP Alt Mode requirements for unmatched compatibility across devices and environments. Designed for professional AV, conferencing, and broadcast applications, this cable ensures reliable high-speed data, power, and video transmission—perfect for demanding projects where performance and flexibility are non-negotiable.

Supporting up to 20Gbps data transfer and 8K-ready video bandwidth, the CAB-UAOC-USBC-10 ensures smooth, ultra-high-definition performance. Integrated Power Delivery provides 60W making it ideal for powering laptops, displays, and peripherals without compromise.

Designed to excel in mission-critical applications, the cable features Kevlar reinforcement, a flexible TPE jacket, and strong EMI/RFI resistance. With plug-and-play functionality, robust tensile strength, and a minimum bend radius of just 65mm, the CAB-UAOC-USBC-10 guarantees dependable performance and durability in conference rooms, broadcast studios, and AV integration projects.
